

### Are Men Fatter?

```{r sex-bmi}
ggplot(snore, aes(x = sex, y = bmi, fill = sex)) +
  geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal()

shapiro.test(snore$bmi[snore$sex == "H"])
shapiro.test(snore$bmi[snore$sex == "F"])
wilcox.test(bmi ~ sex, data = snore)
```

A Wilcoxon rank-sum test showed no significant difference in BMI between men and women (W = 850, p = 0.488), so this stereotype is not supported by the data.
